subject: Deployment readiness: TheraCare implementation action grid
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Initial SOW + high-level kickoff items for TheraCare

Vivek / Monica —

Quick context: closed the TheraCare renewal + expansion last week (50k ARR upsell, 12-month Dedicated plan). They signed the MSA; SOW needs to land then we move to implementation. Target prod launch: 2027-02-15.

Key points and risks:
- Scope: migrate two production endpoints (claims-normalization, triage-chat) to Redwood Dedicated.
- Data flow: TheraCare insists on VPC-only egress for PHI — Private deployment option likely required; security team asked for contact.
- Timeline: onboarding cadence = 6 sprints (2-week sprints) with a pilot in sprint 3.

Attachments: 20261128_SOW_draft.pdf (pdf, draft), redwood-implementation-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

Action items for CS/Implementation team (please own):
1) Assign primary CSM and Implementation Lead (owner and backup).
2) Confirm VPC/on-prem requirements and engage Security for the questionnaire.
3) Schedule 60/30/14-day checkpoints and pilot date.

Monica — can you take primary CSM? Vivek — will you own escalation path and account-level config? Karthik — we need SE support for model mapping and endpoint config. Neha — please flag any compliance blockers.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick alignment call tomorrow.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial SOW + high-level kickoff items for TheraCare

Thanks Marissa — good summary. I’ll pull together the action grid and owners. Quick notes from my side:

- I’ll be exec owner for the transition and will field any SLA/contract escalation.
- Monica confirmed as primary CSM (welcome) — Monica, please confirm availability for a start-of-engagement call next Tue 12/07 or Wed 12/08.
- Karthik, please scope SE work: model mapping, tokenization differences, and latency targets per endpoint (I put a 95th pct < 220ms target in the SOW — verify if realistic).
- Neha, please loop Security: primary contact for TheraCare security questionnaire. I see Marissa flagged VPC-only egress; that will trigger Redwood Private pre-checks.

I’ll create a simple action grid (owners, due dates, blockers) and drop it in the Drive link below. If there are any immediate procurement or legal redlines from TheraCare, CC me.

Next steps (owners):
- Monica (CSM): confirm kickoff meeting date/time + intro deck (owner)
- Karthik (SE): produce technical intake doc by 2026-12-03 (owner)
- Neha (Security): confirm security contact and questionnaire status by 2026-12-02 (owner)
- Marissa (AE): send final SOW to procurement and attach DocuSign link (owner)

Attachments: none here — refer to Marissa’s SOW and checklist.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3C4D-implementation-checklist

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Customer Success Operations, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
From: Alice Park <alice.park@theracare.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: TheraCare Procurement <procurement@theracare.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T17:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial SOW + high-level kickoff items for TheraCare

Hi Marissa / Vivek —

Thanks for the update and the SOW. A few items from our side before we lock dates:

1) Security contact: our infra lead for this project is Dave Liu (dave.liu@theracare.com). I’m attaching a CSV of our security contacts and typical timelines.
2) VPC-only requirement: we can accommodate Private deployment but need a short design review with your Security/Networking team to confirm connectivity (we use Azure ExpressRoute).
3) Procurement: we need the SOW with final Milestone schedule and DocuSign link to process payment. Our procurement team processes vendor paperwork within 7–10 business days after receiving final docs.

Attached: theracare_security_contacts.csv

Proposed kickoff week: 2026-12-13 (preferred) — would that work on your side?

Cheers,
Alice Park
Senior Program Manager, TheraCare Health
alice.park@theracare.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@theracare.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial SOW + high-level kickoff items for TheraCare

Alice — great, thanks for the security contact and timeline. Confirming alignment and owners below so everyone has a single source of truth: 

Owners and short plan:
- Monica Patel (Primary CSM, Redwood): onboarding owner, kickoff facilitation, weekly success metrics (owner)
- Karthik Iyer (Implementation SE, Redwood): technical intake, pilot plan, model mapping (owner)
- Neha Kapoor (Security, Redwood): lead for questionnaire and design review with TheraCare infra (owner)
- Vivek Kulkarni (Transition Exec): escalation, SLA alignment, delivery milestones (owner)
- Marissa Cole (AE): contract closure and invoicing follow-up (owner)

Immediate next steps (week of 2026-12-06):
- Marissa to finalize SOW and send DocuSign (by 2026-12-01).
- Karthik to produce technical intake doc (by 2026-12-03).
- Neha to schedule a security design call with Dave Liu (TheraCare) and provide pre-check list (by 2026-12-02).
- Monica to schedule kickoff for the week of 2026-12-13 and share the agenda (by 2026-12-06).

I’ll open a dedicated Slack channel #cust-theracare and create the onboarding action grid in Drive (link above). If anything changes, flag here and I’ll reassign.

Thanks all — welcome Monica and Karthik; let’s sync 30m tomorrow to make sure owners have dependencies captured.

—Vivek
